page_title: RBL 2-2 DOR | RB Leipzig v Dortmund 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+8' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Maarten Vandevoordt anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.

90+5' 2 - 2 Superb finishing from Fabio Silva (Dortmund). Karim Adeyemi plays a fantastic through ball and finds Fabio Silva (Dortmund), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 2:2.
90+4' Substitution. Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) on for Yan Diomande.
90+3' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is booked for saying more than Benjamin Brand was willing to tolerate.
90+1' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Dortmund for a penalty. Play continues.
85' 13:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
85' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Maarten Vandevoordt comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ridle Baku walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
82' Today's match ends for Brajan Gruda who will be replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
81' The substitution has been made. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) has replaced Romulo Cardoso.
78' Benjamin Brand shows the yellow card to Fabio Silva (Dortmund) for a heavy challenge.
76' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) replaces Marcel Sabitzer.
73' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
72' That will be all from Serhou Guirassy who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fabio Silva (Dortmund).
69' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
68' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
68' The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.
65' Substitution. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) has come on for Xaver Schlager.
65' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Felix Nmecha will be replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yan Couto (Dortmund) for Luca Reggiani.
64' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Serhou Guirassy, but Maarten Vandevoordt displays great awareness to stop him.
64' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maximilian Beier.
62' A pass by Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
61' Dortmund players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
59' The corner kick from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
58' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
54' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Luca Reggiani (Dortmund), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
50' 2 - 1 Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner into the roof of his own net.
49' The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benjamin Brand signals.
48' RB Leipzig hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' The game is interrupted now, Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benjamin Brand ignores the protests.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Dortmund.

44' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the mid-range free kick and sends it towards the roof of the net, but he is denied by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.
41' A yellow card for a tackle by Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig). Benjamin Brand doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
39' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! David Raum laid the ball off to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
38' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Maarten Vandevoordt stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
35' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) dribbles into the box, but Gregor Kobel is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
34' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) for a tough tackle.
27' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Some patient build-up play from Dortmund as they look to unlock the defence.
24' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Yan Diomande plays a pass to the feet of Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.
18' Poor challenge! Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) is penalised for tripping and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
16' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends an accurate short pass. Jobe Bellingham controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
12' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Gregor Kobel comfortably gathers the ball.
11' David Raum (RB Leipzig) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' RB Leipzig are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is behind the touchline and RB Leipzig will take a throw-in.
10' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

8' What a wasted opportunity by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will supervise the game today.
